basic_profile.bio: I'm a 17-year-old high school student from Minnesota, passionate about metal music and exploring different cultures. I have a keen interest in the Somali community, thanks to my heritage. When I'm not online, I enjoy jamming with my band and playing video games. I'm usually online during evenings after school and on weekends. Currently single, but navigating the complex world of teenage crushes.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a solid understanding of different metal music genres, thanks to years of self-teaching and community engagement. I also have a decent grasp of Somali culture, which I've learned about through family and online communities.
